source.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol ReferenceGamesTANUKI: Pon's Summer Releases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol ReferenceLoadingTaking place over one sweltering summer...The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!Taking place over one sweltering summer...Deliver packages Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it'll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery.Sushi Chef, Sumo Wrestler, Baseball Pro! As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they'll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine's restoration.The Island Is Your Playground (or Pon'y Hawk!?)Hop on Pon’s BMX and explore the island on two wheels. Launch off ramps, grind along rails, and string together tricks and combos as you discover new paths, radical heights and everything in between. Restore the shrine to former gloryYou've been tasked with getting the Tanuki Shrine ready for the Great Tanuki Matsuri at the end of summer! Turn your earnings from deliveries, activities and over 100 BMX challenges into a shrine you’re proud of: build, upgrade and make it your own. With the Tanuki Festival just around the corner, Pon must restore the shrine to its former glory. Help him earn cash, befriend the local townsfolk, and prep the shrine for the festival of a lifetime.BMX your way into the hearts of all the townsfolk as a mail delivery Tanuki! You've got one month to save up enough to restore the shrine for the Great Tanuki Festival. Deliver packages, compete in sports, make sushi, and much much more in TANUKI!Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsActionAdventureFree roamingShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 622 MBNintendo Switch 2: 779 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. GamesHillthornVersionNintendo SwitchEditionDigitalBlood, Use of Drugs and Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken. A World in CardsEvery eerie and unsettling detail of Hillthorn's story is revealed entirely through Clue cards, which can be Investigated, Explored or in some instances Talked to in your search to get closer to truth behind the disappearance.You Are an OutsiderYou've been tasked to find a missing person, though it’ll take some finesse to draw information from the locals, who seem reluctant to share details with someone outside their flock.Time is in Short SupplyThe clock is ticking. There are too many threads to follow and too little time. Something seems keen on letting you revisit untrodden paths, but at what cost? Features• Discover a strange mountain and uncover its secrets.• Card-based investigation with no dialogue.• The clock ticks with every action.• Multiple endings to discover• Knowledge as progression.• No Generative AISoftware description provided by the publisher.Related tagsAdventurePuzzle-solving elementsShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 420 MBNintendo Switch 2: 420 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite.
